pick.title: In a rare move, the FDA cites two drugmakers for failing to report clinical trial results to a database
pick.headline: FDA Enforces Trial Reporting Rule, Briefly Startling Industry and Possibly Itself
pick.take: For the first time in more than a year, the FDA sent notices to drugmakers for not reporting required trial results. The requirement has presumably been there the whole time. Transparency is mandatory in roughly the way a speed limit is on a road where the police patrol annually.
